subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly Air China from Manila to Chengdu and visit the Panda Park or Panda Valley, Guanxian Ancient City and Dujiangyan. Spend two hours skiing at Zhegu Mountain (ski equipment included), then explore Chengdu: Broad and Narrow Alley, Jinli Walking Street, Chunxi Road and Taikoo Li. Stays are in local 5-star hotels. This is a shopping-stop package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 10–14 2027 to Jan 17–21 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Panda Park: A panda centre in the Dujiangyan area where visitors can see giant pandas.
placeDesc.Panda Valley: Dujiangyan's panda conservation area; the tour visits either this or Panda Park.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old walled town of Dujiangyan, with traditional streets and shops.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square: A town square in Dujiangyan with a panda statue, popular for selfies.
placeDesc.South Bridge (Blue Tears): A bridge over the Min River in Dujiangyan, a pleasant riverside viewpoint.
placeDesc.Zhegu Mountain Ski Resort: A mountain ski area near Dujiangyan; the tour includes 2 hours of skiing with equipment.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge Bookstore: A visually striking bookstore known for its mirrored, immersive interior design.
placeDesc.Science and Technology Museum: A science museum visited on the way into Chengdu.
placeDesc.Broad and Narrow Alley: A historic area of Chengdu with traditional courtyard lanes, shops and tea houses.
placeDesc.Florentia Village Outlets: An outlet shopping village in Chengdu, designed as a European-style town.
placeDesc.Jinli Walking Street: A pedestrian street in Chengdu with Sichuan-style buildings, snacks and souvenirs.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: Chengdu's main downtown shopping street, lined with malls and stores.
placeDesc.IFS Plaza: A large shopping mall in downtown Chengdu next to Chunxi Road.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping district in Chengdu with a naked-eye 3D LED screen.
